text:
ava: Idea  mystery picnic + mini puzzle hunt next Thursday at noon on the plaza. think picnic blankets, boxed lunches, and 10-minute clue stations around the courtyard. low-pressure, team-friendly. :mag: :sandwich:

cole: that sounds delightful. count me in. i'll make a gentle crossword for one station.

riley: in! can we have a gluten-free lunch option?

jules: yes please on gf. also could we make one clue accessible-friendly (large print)?

morgan: love it. small prize idea: sticker sheets + a silly trophy (plastic) for the first team. inexpensive but fun. react :trophy: if you like.

ava: :trophy: i'm sold. quick logistics q: plaza availability and any permit needs? pinging @facilities.

facilities: Plaza is available noon-2pm on Thursday. No permit needed for under 50 people. We can provide a 10ft mat for accessibility and 3 folding tables if you want them. Reserve through events-bot.

ava: thanks! i'll reserve. @events-bot can you block plaza 11:45-2:15 so we have setup/cleanup buffer?

events-bot: Received. Use `/event reserve --space plaza --start 11:45 --end 14:15 --notes "mystery picnic & puzzle hunt"` to finalize. Include headcount in the reply.

cole: budget q: suggested $12 per boxed lunch. if folks chip in we can keep it cheap. ops-bot any advice on pooled expenses?

ops-bot: For team-socials events, use `/expense submit --amount <total> --category team-socials --notes "mystery picnic lunches"`. Small pooled tabs allowed. Attach receipts for reimbursement.

riley: i'll need a vegetarian & gluten-free box. adding to RSVP.

jules: i'll volunteer to write the large-print clue and help with setup.

morgan: i'll DIY a tiny plastic trophy and print stickers. also happy to coordinate teams on the day.

ava: quick poll: prefer themed puzzles (company trivia + local clues) or random brainteasers? react :one: themed, :two: brainteasers. poll closes Wed noon.

riley: :one: themed sounds fun.

cole: :two: brainteasers for me but either is fine.

ava: sign-up sheet: https://tiny.redwood/mystery-picnic-rsvp  add lunch prefs, plus-ones, and whether you want to write a clue or help setup. closing Wed 5pm.

jules: accessibility note: plaza surface is cobbled in parts. facilities said the mat will help but volunteers should keep clue stations on even paths where possible.

facilities: Correct. We'll place the mat by the main route and mark uneven spots. DM for special assistance.

morgan: timeline idea: 11:45 setup, 12:00 brief + picnic, 12:20 puzzle hunt starts, 1:10 regroup + prizes, 1:30 clean. okay?

ava: sounds perfect. last thing: if anyone can't afford the suggested lunch, DM me and we'll cover. want this to be inclusive. :heart: 

cole: RSVP. added gf vegetarian note.

riley: RSVP +1 (bringing friend). added dietary notes.

jules: RSVP. volunteering for clue + setup.

morgan: RSVP. donating trophy + stickers.

ava: thanks team. will finalize reservation and post reminder Tue morning. excited for puzzles and picnic vibes! :sparkles:
